section_summary.extract_value: This section presents bivariate correlations and hierarchical regression analyses examining relationships between sexual behavior measures and body-related variables (body appreciation, body pride, body image flexibility, and body acceptance from others) separately for women and men. The analyses controlled for sexual orientation, relationship status, age, and BMI in the first regression step, with body-related variables entered simultaneously in the second step. Results indicated that sexual behavior measures were significantly correlated with body appreciation and body pride in both genders, with some gender differences in the specific patterns of association.
